items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens (expected weekend close); fills void from Lamar/Huntley injuries. Not in time for TNF.
items.why: Ravens QB crisis after Jackson IR and Huntley SE.
items.implication: Stabilizes BAL offense ROS; ARI QB situation worsens.
items.opportunity: BAL WRs/TEs upgrade once Brissett arrives.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) DNP all week, listed Questionable; coach Liam Coen says game-time decision for TNF vs BAL. Feels better but no practice.
items.why: Ankle/foot; three DNPs on short week.
items.implication: High risk for TNF; check inactives.
items.opportunity: If OUT/limited, Chris Rodriguez Jr. elevated role/carries.

items.text: Tyler Huntley suffered season-ending turf toe injury Week 8, set for surgery similar to Burrow last year; out rest of season.
Cardinals place rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on IR with high-ankle sprain (new injury, right ankle); out 4-5 weeks. Eligible return Week 13+.
items.why: High-ankle sprain Week 8 vs DAL; third ankle issue this year.
items.implication: ARI RB committee to Allgeier lead; Love stash only deep leagues.
items.opportunity: Tyler Allgeier primary carries/snaps; Bam Knight if clear concussion.

items.text: Lamar Jackson needs surgery on right thumb injury suffered Week 8 vs BUF and will be placed on IR, out indefinitely/potentially season-ending; ruled out for TNF vs JAC. Joe Fagnano starts Thursday.
items.why: Thumb hyperextension on first snap; surgery confirmed by coach Jesse Minter.
items.implication: Ravens QB chaos; Fagnano start short-term, Brissett incoming.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass-catchers volume uncertain under backup; Zay Flowers etc. downgrade short-term.

items.text: 49ers: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) and Mike Evans DNP Wednesday practice; CMC said he 'feels great' and could practice/play this week. Nick Bosa returns.
items.opportunity: If active, full RB1; if out, SF committee.

items.text: Jets WR Garrett Wilson is in the concussion protocol.
items.implication: Week 9 availability TBD; NYJ WR downgrade risk.

items.text: ETR Team-by-Team Week 9: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue.
items.opportunity: Other NE WRs target share bump.

items.text: ETR: Wheels completely fall off for IND, Jonathan Taylor saga continues heading into Week 9.
items.implication: JT start/sit caution; monitor beat reports.

items.text: Levitan/Silva ETR Team-by-Team: BAL loses Lamar Jackson likely for season; AJ Brown out again (knee); IND wheels off, JT saga continues. Full Week 9 flags and roles covered.
items.why: Post-Week 8 injury/role analysis for all teams.
items.implication: Adjust ROS rankings/start-sit for impacted players.
items.opportunity: Focus snaps/routes for remaining BAL/NE/IND options.

items.text: ETR waiver: Mike Washington Jr. handed LV workhorse RB role Week 8 (25-2 carry edge over Ashton Jeanty). Workload sticky TBD but noteworthy; Jeanty still pass-down lead.
items.why: 25 carries Washington vs 2 Jeanty; coach Kubiak 'moving target' week-to-week.
items.implication: Washington waiver priority; Jeanty flex/handcuff downgrade if split sticks.
items.opportunity: Washington snaps/carries expansion; Jeanty targets remain high.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) out Sunday vs Chargers; has made progress but remains sidelined per HC DeMeco Ryans.
items.why: Groin; progress noted but not enough.

items.text: Packers DE Micah Parsons (knee) returns to practice (individual drills) for first time since Dec 2025 PUP; limited officially. 21-day window.
items.implication: GB defense upgrade potential soon; fantasy IDP.

items.text: Berry Fantasy Life Happy Hour Week 9 waivers: Recap Bears offense surge; breakdown Seattle backfield outlook; top adds all positions. Sit/start mailbag reacts to Love IR.
items.why: MNF recap + waiver priorities post-Love IR and other news.
items.implication: Prioritize SEA RBs and emerging roles per Love/Hate style.
